description: This PHP class 'AccessEmployeeFileController' handles HTTP requests to provide employee data in JSON format, specifically for maintenance tasks within the OrangeHRM system. It manages access control, data retrieval, and response formatting.

classes.name: AccessEmployeeFileController
classes.description: A controller class to handle access to employee data files in JSON format, with permission checks and response formatting.

methods.name: getDownloadFormat
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the JSON download format instance used for data formatting.

methods.name: getMaintenanceService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the maintenance service instance responsible for accessing employee data.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming HTTP requests, checks permissions, retrieves employee data for given employee number, and returns a formatted JSON response or a bad request response.
